coverage_override.reason: The hand summon procedure plus resulting FIRE lock are one procedure unit; the detached-material damage trigger plus HOPT is the second.

effects.printed_clause: Empty field or Dragon Xyz hand Special Summon procedure, followed by a FIRE Special Summon lock for the turn.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable hand procedure checks the field condition and registers a FIRE Special Summon restriction through the End Phase after this summon.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers a procedure-result Special Summon restriction with phase reset.

effects.printed_clause: If detached from a Stellaer Xyz to activate its effect: inflict total Rank of all monsters you control x100. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: GLOBALFLAG_DETACH_EVENT and EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL catch detachment regardless of destination. The condition verifies prior overlay location, cost reason, and Stellaer Xyz source; target and resolution recalculate the total positive Rank and inflict that amount times 100.

official_references.matched_structure: Enables and registers a trigger on EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL.
Sums a live monster statistic and converts it into an effect amount.

effects.issue: Fixed: EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL replaces EVENT_TO_GRAVE, so a legal detach to another destination still triggers.
